title: Engineer, Finance Systems
description:
Are you our “***TYPE***”?

  

Brands constantly seek to achieve deeper appeal and connection with their target audience and customers. They express themselves in unique ways, in ways that are meaningful, attractive, and compelling to their audience. Fonts play a key role in this and are central to every brand’s visual identity and expression.

  

Headquartered in the Boston area of the United States and with offices across 4 continents, Monotype is the world’s leading company in fonts. It’s a trusted partner to the world’s top brands and was named “One of the Most Innovative Companies in Design for 2018” by Fast Company.


Monotype brings brands to life through the type and technology that consumers engage with every day. The company's rich legacy includes a library that can be traced back hundreds of years, featuring famed typefaces like Helvetica, Neue Frutiger, Gotham, Times New Roman and more. Monotype also provides a first\-of\-its\-kind service that makes fonts more accessible for creative professionals to discover, license, and use in our increasingly digital world. We work with the biggest global brands, and with individual creatives, offering a wide set of solutions that make it easier for them to do what they do best: **design beautiful brand experiences.**


Monotype Solutions India is a strategic center of excellence for Monotype and is a certified Great Place to Work® three years in a row. The India center is the largest headcount location of Monotype. It is based in NOIDA, Sector 125 (Delhi/NCR). The focus of this fast\-growing center spans Product Development, Product Management, Experience Design, User Research, Market Intelligence, Research in areas of Artificial Intelligence and Machine learning, Innovation, Customer Success, Enterprise Business Solutions, and Sales.


We are seeking an **Application Engineer** to join the Finance team, where you’ll play a key role in supporting Finance systems and driving process improvements. This role is more than maintaining applications it’s about partnering with Finance stakeholders to develop innovative solutions, automate workflows, and enable smarter business decisions. If you thrive at the intersection of technology, data, and collaboration, this position offers the chance to make a lasting impact on how Finance operates.

 **What you’ll be doing:**

* Own the reliability, performance, and scalability of Finance business systems built on Microsoft SQL Server and .NET.
* Design, develop, and optimize backend services, APIs, and integrations using C\# (.NET 6\+), T\-SQL, and ETL pipelines (e.g., SSIS/Azure Data Factory).
* Model data and author performant objects (tables, indexes, views, stored procedures, functions) to support Finance reporting and month\-end close.
* Build and maintain integrations with ERP, billing, and data warehouse systems (REST/GraphQL, webhooks, file\-based, queues).
* Troubleshoot production issues across application, database, and integration layers; perform root\-cause analysis and preventive fixes.
* Implement CI/CD and version control practices using GitHub (Actions), including automated tests and deployment pipelines.
* Partner with Finance stakeholders to translate requirements into technical designs; deliver solutions that improve accuracy, timeliness, and control.
* Partner with the Finance Systems team on AI\-driven automation initiatives, including applying LLM\-based tools and agentic workflows to streamline royalty, order\-to\-cash, and close processes.
* Build and maintain integrations with AI services (e.g., Azure Cognitive Services, Anthropic/OpenAI APIs) to support intelligent document processing, anomaly detection, and workflow automation across Finance systems.
* Evaluate and prototype emerging AI tools and techniques to identify opportunities for reducing manual effort in Finance operations.
* Leverage Azure services (Functions, Service Bus/Queues, Key Vault; Cognitive Services where valuable) to automate workflows and validations.
* Contribute to operational reporting; Power BI/DAX exposure is a plus for self\-service dashboards and data validation.
* Maintain technical documentation, change logs, and configuration artifacts to meet audit/compliance standards.
* Support release planning, regression testing, and cutover for upgrades and new implementations; champion process improvements.

 **Scope \& Impact:**

* Acts as the technical SME for .NET and database engineering within Finance systems.
* Ensures system accuracy, performance, and compliance that directly affect close processes, revenue/royalty calculations, and analytics.
* Shares ownership, alongside the Finance Systems team, of AI\-enabled tooling that supports Foundry and royalty operations, ensuring these capabilities scale as adoption grows.
* Delivers medium\-complexity solutions independently; partners on architecture and serves as an escalation point for critical incidents.

 **What we’re looking for:**

* Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or equivalent experience.
* 3–5\+ years building production software with C\# and .NET (ASP.NET Core/Workers/Functions).
* Advanced SQL Server skills: data modeling, T\-SQL, indexing, query tuning, transaction handling, and performance troubleshooting.
* Hands\-on ETL/integration experience (SSIS, Azure Data Factory, or similar); strong understanding of data quality and reconciliation.
* Experience building and securing RESTful APIs; familiarity with authentication/authorization patterns (OAuth/OpenID Connect).
* Git/GitHub proficiency for branching, code reviews, and CI/CD (GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps).
* Familiarity with Azure services (Functions, Service Bus, Storage, Key Vault, Cognitive Services).
* Exposure to applying AI/LLM tools to business process automation (e.g., prompt engineering, retrieval\-augmented generation, agentic workflows) is a strong plus.
* Nice to have: ORM familiarity (Entity Framework Core), message\-based integration patterns, scripting (PowerShell), and exposure to Power BI/DAX.
* Strong problem\-solving and communication skills; able to explain technical concepts to non\-technical partners and document clearly.
* Highly organized, adaptable, and comfortable juggling multiple priorities in a fast\-moving environment.

  

Monotype is an Equal Opportunities Employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. \#LI\-DNI

title: Financial Analyst (FP&A) in Manufacturing team
description:
Noida, India Category Finance Posted Date 09/28/2026 Job Id 366115
  
**About Signify**

  

  

Through bold discovery and cutting\-edge innovation, we lead an industry that is vital for the future of our planet: lighting. Through our leadership in connected lighting and the Internet of Things, we're breaking new ground in data analytics, AI, and smart solutions for homes, offices, cities, and beyond.

  

  

At Signify, you can shape tomorrow by building on our incredible 125\+ year legacy while working toward even bolder sustainability goals. Our culture of continuous learning, creativity, and commitment to diversity and inclusion empowers you to grow your skills and career.

  

  

Join us, and together, we’ll transform our industry, making a lasting difference for brighter lives and a better world.

Analyzes financial data to support decision\-making processes. Prepares reports and forecasts to guide business strategies. Collaborates with cross\-functional teams to optimize financial performance.

* Analyse key drivers/ reports of business performance, including monthly and quarterly results and variance analysis, revise projections as appropriate, prepare forward looking insights and scenarios

* Partners with business leaders to provide input and guidance on business issues and to provide strategic financial input and leadership on decision\-making issues affecting business performance.

With a global workforce present in 70\+ countries, we are dedicated to creating an inclusive environment where every voice is heard and valued, helping us all achieve more together.

  

  

Come join us, and together we can light up the future.

title: Accountant
description:
**Accounts Executive / Billing Executive**

**Location:** Noida  
**Salary:** ₹16,000 – ₹20,000 per month  
**Experience:** 1–2 years preferred  
**Qualification:** B.Com / M.Com or relevant qualification  
**Employment Type:** Full\-time

**Job Overview**

We are looking for a detail\-oriented and responsible Accountant / Billing Executive to manage daily accounting, billing, invoicing, cash transactions, and financial records. The candidate will be responsible for ensuring that all accounting and billing entries are accurate, updated, and properly documented.

The ideal candidate should have practical knowledge of Tally, MS Excel, billing, invoicing, and basic accounting procedures.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Manage day\-to\-day accounting and financial transactions.
* Prepare and issue sales invoices, bills, receipts, and payment documents.
* Enter and maintain daily accounting transactions in Tally.
* Maintain accurate records of sales, purchases, receipts, and payments.
* Handle daily billing activities and ensure invoices are generated accurately and on time.
* Maintain petty cash and daily cash records.
* Record cash and bank receipts and payments accurately.
* Verify billing details, amounts, taxes, and supporting documents before processing.
* Maintain and organize invoices, bills, vouchers, receipts, and other accounting documents.
* Maintain proper records of customer and vendor transactions.
* Track outstanding payments and assist in following up on pending receivables.
* Perform basic reconciliation of cash, sales, and accounting records.
* Maintain proper filing and documentation of all financial records.
* Prepare basic reports related to sales, purchases, expenses, cash, and outstanding payments.
* Use MS Excel for maintaining records, preparing reports, and basic data analysis.
* Coordinate with the operations, sales, and management teams regarding billing and accounting\-related matters.
* Ensure all accounting entries and documents are completed within the required timelines.
* Assist the senior accountant or management with other accounting and finance\-related activities as required.
* Maintain confidentiality of company financial and customer\-related information.

**Required Skills \& Qualifications**

* B.Com / M.Com or a relevant accounting qualification is preferred.
* 1–2 years of experience in accounting, billing, or finance\-related work is preferred.
* Good working knowledge of Tally.
* Basic knowledge of MS Excel.
* Understanding of basic accounting principles.
* Practical knowledge of invoicing and billing processes.
* Good numerical and calculation skills.
* Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
* Good organizational and record\-keeping skills.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks and meet deadlines.
* Good communication and coordination skills.
* Responsible, punctual, and disciplined approach to work.

**Preferred Candidate**

Candidates with hands\-on experience in Tally, billing, invoicing, cash handling, sales/purchase entries, and maintaining accounting records will be preferred.

Freshers with good accounting knowledge and practical knowledge of Tally may also be considered.

Pay: ₹16,000\.00 \- ₹20,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Financial Analyst - Renewable Energy
description:
**FINANCIAL ANALYST \- DEVELOPMENT (BESS Experience)**

**Who We Are?**

Cleantech Industry Resources accelerates United States solar, battery storage and EV projects by providing turnkey development as a service including 100% internal systems engineering. The company deploys a leading team that spun out of the largest solar power producer in the world. This team operates within a sophisticated suite of software to support projects from land origination, through to commercial operation.

**Location of Position:**

* Noida

**What We Offer**

* Opportunity to join a top\-notch, collaborative team of professionals
* Fantastic team environment and collaborative culture
* Professional development opportunities to grow into an industry leader
* Medical Insurance for the employee and family
* Spot Recognition bonus for exceptional performance
* Long Term Incentive policy
* Regular team outings, events, and activities to foster a positive work environment

**Our Commitment to Diversity**

At CIR, we are dedicated to nurturing a diverse and equitable workforce that truly reflects our community. We deeply value each person’s unique perspective, skills, and experiences. CIR embraces all individuals, regardless of race, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, or nationality. We are steadfast in our commitment to fostering a just and inclusive world through intentional policies and actions. Your individuality enriches our collective strength, and we strive to ensure everyone feels respected, valued, and empowered.

**Position Summary**

We are seeking a highly motivated and detail\-oriented Financial Analyst to join our development team. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in financial modelling, analysis, and reporting, with specific experience in the renewable energy sector. This role requires a deep understanding of financial principles and the ability to apply them in the context of renewable energy projects, including solar, wind, and other sustainable initiatives.

**Core Responsibilities**  
**Financial Modeling \& Valuation**

* Develop, maintain, and review sophisticated project finance models for renewable energy and infrastructure projects, including Utility\-Scale Solar, BESS, Solar\+BESS, Wind, Green Hydrogen, EV Charging Infrastructure, Data Centers, and other emerging technologies across the North American market.
* Build dynamic financial models incorporating project revenues, operating expenses, tax incentives, depreciation, financing structures, and investment returns.
* Perform scenario, sensitivity, and Monte Carlo analyses to evaluate project risks, investment returns, and key value drivers.
* Assess project economics using financial metrics including NPV, IRR, LCOE, DSCR, Equity IRR, Project IRR, Payback Period, and Cash Flow Analysis.
* Support the development of merchant, hybrid, tolling, capacity market, ancillary service, and revenue stacking models for renewable energy and energy storage projects.

**Investment \& Commercial Due Diligence**

* Perform financial due diligence for acquisitions, project financing, M\&A transactions, strategic partnerships, and investment opportunities.
* Review project assumptions, commercial agreements, CAPEX/OPEX estimates, revenue forecasts, tax incentives, and financing structures to identify financial risks and opportunities.
* Prepare investment memorandums, lender presentations, and executive summaries for developers, investors, lenders, and senior leadership.
* Evaluate project bankability and commercial viability throughout different stages of project development.

**Budgeting \& Forecasting:**

* Assist in the preparation of annual budgets and long\-term financial forecasts.
* Monitor actual performance against budget, providing variance analysis and actionable insights.
* Collaborate with project teams to develop accurate cost estimates and financial forecasts.

**Investment Analysis:**

* Perform detailed financial due diligence on potential renewable energy investments.
* Prepare investment memos and presentations for senior management and stakeholders.
* Evaluate the financial viability of new projects, partnerships, and acquisitions.

**Reporting \& Compliance:**

* Prepare and present monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reports to senior management.
* Ensure compliance with industry regulations, tax laws, and company policies.
* Support external audits and provide necessary documentation and explanations.

**Market Research \& Industry Trends:**

* Monitor North American electricity markets, renewable energy policies, tax incentives, ISO/RTO market developments, and emerging revenue opportunities.
* Analyze the financial impact of market trends, merchant pricing, REC markets, ancillary services, capacity markets, inflation, interest rates, and regulatory changes.
* Evaluate the commercial implications of incentive programs such as ITC, PTC, IRA, MACRS, LCFS, VDER, SGIP, and other applicable federal and state\-level programs.

**Client Advisory \& Consulting**

* Work directly with renewable energy developers, IPPs, infrastructure investors, private equity firms, lenders, utilities, and independent engineers to deliver high\-quality financial consulting services.
* Translate complex financial analyses into clear, actionable recommendations tailored to client objectives and investment strategies.
* Present financial models, investment analyses, and commercial recommendations during client meetings, technical discussions, and management reviews.
* Support proposal preparation, commercial discussions, and scope development for financial advisory engagements.

**Collaboration \& Support:**

* Work closely with cross\-functional teams including engineering, operations, and project management.
* Provide financial support and guidance to project managers and business development teams.
* Participate in strategic planning and business development initiatives.

**Education Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field; MBA or CFA is a plus.

**Technical Skills and Experience**

**Software/Language Proficiency:**

* Advanced MS Office
* Python
* AI tools

**Project Management:**

* Experience in managing design projects from conception to implementation
* Ability to coordinate with other engineers and stakeholders

**Renewable Energy Systems:**

* Understanding of solar energy systems and their integration into existing infrastructure

**Experience**

* At least 4 years of relevant experience in financial analysis, preferably in Renewable Energy Sector. (Consultancy and Analyst experience is highly preferred).
* Strong proficiency in financial modelling, forecasting, and analysis tools (e.g., Excel, Python, AT tools, financial software).
* Knowledge of renewable energy project financing, including PPAs, tax credits, and subsidies.
* Excellent analytical, problem\-solving, and communication skills.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast\-paced environment.
* Familiarity with industry\-specific regulations, incentives, and market dynamics.
* Experience with ERP systems and financial reporting software is preferred.

**Psychosocial Skills /Human Skills/Behavioural Skills**

* Strong analytical, organizational, and problem\-solving skills.
* Project Management experience a plus.
* Entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to take ideas and run with them from concept to conclusion.
* Technical understanding of clean energy business processes
* Exceptional verbal and writing communication skills with superiors, peers, partners, and other stakeholders.
* Excellent interpersonal skills while managing multiple priorities in a fast\-paced and ever\-changing environment.
* Excellence in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)

**Physical Demands**

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. The physical demands of this job require an individual to be able to work at a computer for most of the day, be able to participate in conference calls and travel to team retreats on a time\-to\-time basis. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

The work environment is usually quiet (normal city traffic noises are common), a blend of artificial and natural light, temperate and generally supports a collaborative work environment. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Our choices in employment are free from any bias related to race, creed, nationality, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, physical limitations, veteran status, or any other legally safeguarded attributes.

Join our Consulting Financial Crime practice to lead our markets and the clients we serve within the financial services industry. For nearly 20 years, Crowe has been the leader in providing financial crime service to the financial community. We are a diverse, innovative, and driven group that operates across the country. We collaborate with the leading providers and organizations in financial services to bring our clients leading solutions.  

  

The **Financial Crime Review Analyst** is responsible for performing transaction activity reviews, investigations and customer due diligence reviews on customers that have been alerted for potentially suspicious activity, potential sanctions list matches or that have been identified as posing elevated risk for money laundering and terrorist financing. They will be responsible for ensuring that reviews and investigations are maintained at a level commensurate with regulatory expectations. This role will assist in Suspicious Activity Reporting (SAR), and/or enhanced due diligence (EDD) reviews on customers identified as posing a higher inherent risk and/or sanctions screening. This position has minimal/no travel.

**Responsibilities:**

* Reviewing and investigating alerts, performing investigations, or enhanced due diligence reviews for potentially suspicious activity, making risk\-based SAR recommendations and preparing SARs.
* Conducting periodic holistic reviews of higher risk individuals or entities.
* Reviewing and investigating potential matches with sanction lists.
* Maintaining a solid working knowledge (functional and operational) of the rules and regulations, including but not limited to, BSA, USA PATRIOT Act, OFAC and Sanctions Screening.
* Assist in the delivery of financial crime consulting services to Financial Services companies, including Banks, Money Service Businesses (MSB’s), Third Party Payment Providers, and FinTechs.
* Handle other duties as assigned by employer.

**Basic Qualifications:**

* High School diploma.
* 1\-year minimum experience in financial services Financial Crime compliance management, retail banking, commercial banking, and/or global diversified financial services organizations.
* Knowledge of the laws applicable to money laundering, to include the BSA, USA PATRIOT Act, OFAC requirements and Suspicious Activity Reporting requirements.
* Strong writing, analytical, and communication skills and the ability to multi\-task and complete projects on time.
* Strong research skills and sound knowledge in the use of the Microsoft Office Suite and experience with on\-line research systems including the Internet.
* Knowledge of client and transactional monitoring processes.
* Detail oriented with the ability to multitask and quickly adapt to changing assignments.
* Ability to work autonomously and with teams in different locations.
* Highly effective communication with all levels of the organization.
* Ability to anticipate, draw conclusions, and adapt to changing needs and demands.
* Excellent verbal, written and interpersonal communication skills, including the ability to communicate effectively with all levels of staff and management.
* Strong analytical skills, problem solving, strategic thinking and reasoning abilities.
* A high degree of integrity, professionalism, and capacity to excel in a cohesive team environment.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Associate’s degree and/or Bachelor’s degree
* Certified Anti\-Money Laundering Specialists (CAMS), or other relevant professional certification.
* Experience performing AML and financial crime investigations, customer due diligence reviews and/or sanctions screening reviews.
* Experience working in AML software solutions including transaction monitoring systems, customer risk rating systems, and/or case management tools like Actimize, Verafin, Fiserv, FCRM, Jack Henry Yellow Hammer, Patriot Officer.
* General banking compliance knowledge.
* Experience working in a professional services or project\-based environment.
* Expertise in common financial crime technology platforms like CLEAR, LexisNexus, World Check, etc.
* Prior financial crime consulting experience.
* Bilingual in Spanish.
